module: Chooses and activates the game's light manager. It loads all init.lua files from the subfolders of lua/ge/client/lighting/ (advanced, basic, shadowMaps), then first tries $pref::lightManager, otherwise goes through the names of the defaultLightManagerNames setting. If none works, the game exits with "Failed to set a light manager!".
notes: initLightingSystems and reloadLightingSystems have an identical body in the code; the only difference is the name.
The GFX Null Device test does nothing (comment: we cannot return here or it crashes later).

initLightingSystems.desc: Loads the lighting modules and activates a light manager via setLightManager; exits the game with an error message if none is usable.

reloadLightingSystems.desc: Same logic as initLightingSystems, called by reloadClient.
